items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: I got over there and I made friends with Howard and all of them

ctx.x: Or even a little tin pipe.

Well, I used to play a harmonica when I was a kid. I played that for long until I got to be a man, young man. Then I started out taking lessons with drums in 1925. And in 26, I started out, I mean, in 26, I started out with Howard.
Mm-hmm. Oh, you might tell a bit about your family, too. Did any of your parents or brothers or older brothers or anyone play?
